name: VaultSparkStudios.github.io
currentFocus: S308 answered the founder editorial-engine directive structurally and DEPLOYED it. The debate was one-dimensional by construction (a single direction scalar, heat as mean distance on it), so a second axis (horizon) was added rather than a fourth pundit, with heatBreakdown naming the split shape; backward compatibility is structural so published heat provably cannot move. The cast grew by epistemic role (VERA production practitioner, ECHO cycle historian, JUNO consequence desk) with REX/MARA/DOT retained because the hash-chained ledger references their ids. EDITIONS moved volume discipline per-edition; a corroboration-first trend radar (56 self-tests) replaced hand-fed sourcing, and two silent bugs were root-fixed by running it (aggregator redirects had collapsed every outlet to one domain, killing corroboration; vendor case studies scored as news) taking the live queue 7 to 24. The Dispatch newsletter is live and identity-free. Commit 09cba82c5 landed on main after two rebases against the hourly publisher crons, then promoted through the content lane (run 31272775770) to 215 paths. Live-verified: /news/ serves the CTA, six-persona board and new voices; /news/subscribed/ went 404 to 200. The Obelisk staging-callback hold is untouched.
publicNote: The Desk now argues with six named voices instead of three, splits on timing as well as on worth, and has The Dispatch — a free email with no account required. All live at vaultsparkstudios.com/news.
